scope: Current MCP bridge, filestore, reducers and tests; historicalSha256 preserves superseded source pins; no compatibility is inferred from names.

conditionalSupportSet.authority: Only policy-admitted byte-identical original-attached/native Board pairs. Pure pinned preflight does not grant authority or migrate inline Markdown.
conditionalSupportSet.commands: Worker create, edit, claim, release, comment and transition only when original worker and native Board-agent pure preflight produce equivalent full Board effects and audit; native schemas, focus and CAS still apply.
conditionalSupportSet.upsert: Fixed mcp:external create/edit only where the same preflight proves exact equivalence; reasonless edits and incompatible native creation shapes are unavailable.
conditionalSupportSet.results: Full original {ok,digest,items} snapshots durably journaled under exact operation, actor and arguments; historical replay never rereads current state.
conditionalSupportSet.excluded: Inline Markdown writes, worker tokens, acceptance, reopen, assign, delete, restore, legacy labels requiring user reconciliation, non-equivalent audit or metadata effects.

unsupported.writes: Only explicitly admitted byte-identical Board authority, a durable workspace-wide admission/recovery fence and a separately journaled full-snapshot receipt are supported. Inline Markdown, unadmitted Boards and non-equivalent effects remain unavailable; no implicit conversion.
unsupported.workerTokens: Native authenticated actor is not an original Board-scoped worker-token resolver.
unsupported.discovery: Canonical Note snapshot rejects some malformed documents globally rather than the original per-Note error row; such cases fail explicitly.

requiredIntegrationSeams: Register definitions and trusted native host in Core after binding host to the exact leased workspace.

Before serving any requests after restart, fence on legacy_note_workitems_intent; replay only its exact authenticated envelope through the canonical native operationId until its full-snapshot receipt is durable.
Bind original Note and native Board authority by reviewed pinned conversion and preserve original bytes/history; assert the binding during each fenced dispatch.
Route reads and discovery for admitted Boards to the journal's fenced current native Board snapshot, not the retained source backing; unadmitted Notes continue using the original read host.
Resolve original Board worker grants only through a trusted native authentication policy, never caller actor fields.
Use the existing native focus authority and durable recovery for every Board effect; do not silently migrate or claim unrelated work.
